test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about the moist deciduous forests of India?

options.text: They grow in regions with rainfall of 100-200 cm.
They are found in the foothills of Himalayas.
They are found in the plains of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
Sal, amla, shisham and mahua are some of the main species of these forests.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They are found in the plains of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Moist deciduous forests** primarily grow in areas with rainfall between 100 to 200 cm.
 
• They are prevalent in the **foothills of the Himalayas, parts of central India, and along the eastern Ghats.**
